elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly permits Customer to engage any supplier and states that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment; the conflicting offer-matching restriction in former Section 7.2 is absent.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies at all, so there is no exclusivity extending beyond a defined product category.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies for any duration, which is no longer than 12 months.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity obligation exists, so none could remain binding following a service-level failure.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity obligation exists, so none could remain binding following a delivery-date failure.
